title: Recommendations for cleaning of premises and plants using asbestos fibres
clause_1_scope: This standard lays down the recommendations for cleaning of premises and plants using asbestos fibres.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Recommendations for personal protection of workers engaged in handling asbestos
Recommendations for disposal of asbestos waste material

clause_3_terminology: Recommendations for cleaning of premises and plants using asbestos fibres

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
